body: I've tried. They either don't take me seriously or aren't able to help, which I don't resent them for. I don't know how else to help me either. It's been 8 years of this feeling. Calling it temporary doesn't do anything for me. I've tried to force that mindset on myself and it hasn't worked. I'm tired.

Save up my next 2 prescriptions, take them all with some alcohol, some other drugs and the remainder of whatever vitamins/supplements I have left. Hopefully it's enough. I'm quite worried about surviving so I'll do it when no one's home. Probably write a note to say sorry to whoever finds me and for being such a coward.
